limitations: No normative CiA specification text was obtained; every CiA 301/305/306/402 fact in principles.md comes from CiA public overview pages, the CiA poster already stored at docs/reference/public/canopen_poster_2024.pdf, vendor restatements or open-source implementations.
CiA 402 option-code values 3, 4, 7 and 8 (current-limit and voltage-limit stops) and the CiA 402-2 v5.0.0 additions (64-bit positions, new modes) are not documented by any stored free source.
Vendor manuals restate the standard with device-specific deviations; principles.md marks every vendor-derived fact.

maxon EPOS4 documents are stored in the sibling pack docs/reference/maxon_epos4_canopen (built concurrently) and the Nanotec N5 manual in docs/reference/multidrive; they are cited through cross_references, not duplicated.
No firmware, SDK or installer executed; no hardware contacted; no login used.
